notes:
Add an explicit account arrangement mode and fix account dragging on Windows.

- Right-click an account and choose Arrange account positions.
- Drag handles appear only while arranging; move accounts using the dots on the left.
- Confirm saves the new order; Cancel or Escape discards the preview.
- Restore rectangle selection in normal mode.
- Use captured pointer gestures instead of native HTML drag-and-drop for ordering.
- Keep the draft available when saving fails and retain account data when confirming order.
